{"confidence": 0.92, "findings": ["Document-ID: persistence-overview
Section: overview
Excerpt: The persistence guide distinguishes checkpointers from stores. A checkpointer saves graph-state snapshots for one thread, while a store keeps application-defined data that can be shared across threads.
Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/persistence", "Document-ID: persistence-quickstart
Section: quickstart
Excerpt: The documented quickstart compiles a graph with a checkpointer and invokes it with configurable.thread_id. The thread identifier groups checkpoints for the same thread.
Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/persistence", "Document-ID: persistence-restart
Section: troubleshooting
Excerpt: The documentation states that an in-memory checkpointer keeps checkpoints in RAM and loses them when the process restarts. A persistent backend is needed when restart recovery is required.
